status: Fixed — source and frozen TypeScript build gate agree on nullable HEAD handling
area: Source-first execution can succeed while frozen tsc cannot compile the same tree
finding: A source-first CLI path can execute and a focused test can pass while `tsc -p tsconfig.build.json` still fails, so a sealed runner-sync build is refused even though operators already treated the source as runnable. The observed seam was optional/nullable HEAD metadata (`string | null`) assigned into a report field typed as definite `string`. Duplicate census: ATM-BUG-2026-08-19-001 is live-index parent-blob residue after a successful commit, not this compile gate. ATM-BUG-2026-07-14-183 is runner-sync/stale-runner dogfood, not a source-vs-frozen typecheck split. The rule is type-flow shaped: runtime-optional metadata must stay optional in the public report type until a fail-closed assertion narrows it.
expectedBehavior: Optional or nullable HEAD metadata is typed as optional or nullable until a fail-closed check proves it is present. After that check, TypeScript must treat the value as `string` so frozen `tsc -p tsconfig.build.json` and source-first execution agree. Missing HEAD remains fail-closed and must not mutate parent/index/worktree verification. Passing source-first execution is not evidence that the frozen build compiler will accept the same tree.
evidenceOrRepro: 2026-08-20 runner-sync steward `runner-sync-4508d330` sealed to HEAD `2f8322cadcc893ae017b7bbd222361e399608736`. `node atm.dev.mjs git reconcile-live-index` ran. Frozen `ATM_RETAIN_RELEASE_ARTIFACTS=1 npm run build` failed with TS2322 at packages/cli/src/commands/git-governance/implementation/live-index-reconciliation.ts:470 (`Type 'string | null' is not assignable to type 'string'`). Error code `ATM_SEALED_RUNNER_BUILD_FAILED`. Inner command: `node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .atm-runtime-cache/tsconfig.build.tsbuildinfo`. Focused coverage: packages/cli/src/commands/git-governance/implementation/live-index-reconciliation.test.ts (present HEAD keeps existing report semantics; missing HEAD fail-closes without index mutation; parent/index/worktree retention cases remain).
followUp: The nullable HEAD report path is repaired (cbaf778e5 and subsequent reconciliation work). 2026-09-02 node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit passed against current source, and frozen dist contains the corresponding reconciliation implementation. Continue to require tsconfig.build validation before every runner publication; source-first execution alone is insufficient evidence.
